requirements.text: Students should be able to search for books and check availability online.
Students can borrow, return, and renew books through the system.
Booking study rooms should be possible from phones, with a calendar and room availability.
Students can only book rooms if they have no outstanding fines.
Students should be able to view and pay fines online.
System should provide notifications or reminders for bookings.
Students should see a list of overdue books when viewing fines.
